tools.name: penny_get_skill
tools.description: Read the current Penny operating skill when session start reports a stale or missing copy. Default: SKILL.md; use a manifest file path when its cue applies. After user approval, view:install returns the exact archive and per-file hashes. Retain results before displaying bounded sections; do not tran

tools.name: penny_start_setup
tools.description: Setup in phases; omit phase to start, resume from meta.onboarding.phase. skipForGood opts out. Stage encrypted imports for dashboard review; status checks receipts. Only users save/cancel there. Imported counts are server-derived; finish cannot complete an active import.

tools.name: penny_session_start
tools.description: Before calling, read the installed Penny skill and report installedSkillStatus (versioned, unversioned, or missing), installedSkillVersion and installedSkillSha256 from its metadata when versioned, and installedSkillSource. If this host cannot install skills, report missing/unsupported. Do not guess

tools.name: penny_read
tools.description:
Before answering anything the user's history, preferences, or prior work would inform, read — search rather than assume nothing is on file.
Read from the user's memory. Choosing `target` — walk this ladder, first match wins:
1. A fact about the user or their people (names, preferences, relationships

tools.name: penny_write
tools.description:
Save the moment something durable emerges — a decision, preference, plan, correction, a to-do, a measurement, or something you produced — mid-conversation and unprompted; when the call is close, save.
Write something new to the user's memory. Choosing `entityType` — walk this ladder top to bottom, f

tools.name: penny_edit
tools.description: When the user corrects something on file, or a task, tracker, skill, or block needs to change, edit the existing item rather than writing a duplicate. Modify something that already exists in the user's memory, chosen by `entityType` — same taxonomy as `penny_write` (see its ladder). Notes take `upda

tools.name: penny_delete
tools.description: Move to Trash. Project: projectId + expectedRevision + operationId; penny_edit op:restore recovers. Repeat in_progress with the same operationId; report partial_recovery conflicts. Note/tracker_entry: ids (max100); skill/rhythm: one id; profile_block: ids are block names. Tag/link removal uses the i
